key.name: language
key.description: Its code: de, en, es, fr, it or ru. Empty, or a language whose speech model is not installed: the first of the user's languages with one, else English.

key.name: talk-brain
key.description: A server's address (https://…/v1: the VibeOS Agent gateway, an OpenAI-style API; the phone enrolls with its device id), or a GGUF file's path to answer on the phone itself. Empty, or a file that is not there: the first model in vibeos-dictate/brain under the user's data directory or the system's.

key.name: talk-voice
key.description: A Piper or Kokoro ONNX model's path. Empty, or a file that is not there: the first voice in vibeos-dictate/voices/LANGUAGE under the user's data directory or the system's.

key.name: talk-voice-name
key.description: The voice file's name in the model's voices directory (af_heart). Empty: the first there is. Piper voices have one speaker each and ignore it.

key.name: talk-speed
key.description: "Speech rate" in Agent's settings: 1.0 is the voice's own pace, up to 3.0 for people used to fast speech.

key.name: talk-verbosity
key.description: "Answers" in Agent's settings: short (a sentence), normal (one to three), or detailed. The model is told it.

key.name: cue-sounds
key.description: A short sound when Agent starts listening, starts working on an answer, is done, or failed; only when the phone's sound is on.

key.name: cue-haptics
key.description: A short vibration when Agent starts listening, starts working on an answer, is done, or failed; not in Silent mode.

key.name: talk-speak
key.description: Off, the replies are only written: the speaker button in Agent's bar.

key.name: talk-listen-again
key.description: Once a reply has been spoken to its end, Agent listens for the next thing the user says, as in a conversation.

key.name: talk-private
key.description: Agent's replies play only in headphones or earbuds when they are connected; on the speaker they are short, with no names, numbers or message texts read aloud.

key.name: announce-calls
key.description: Agent says who is calling, even when it is not open, and listens for "answer" or "decline". Open, it always does. It starts with the session while this is on.

key.name: quiet-hours
key.description: A time range, "HH:MM-HH:MM" (it may go over midnight), in which Agent says nothing and plays no cue on its own; '' for none.

key.name: quiet-calls
key.description: Calls are still announced in the quiet hours.

key.name: debug-log
key.description: Agent records each turn whole on the phone, and nowhere else: what it sent to the model, what came back, each tool's call with its arguments and result, the times and the errors. Its newest 100 turns are kept, 5 MB at most.

key.name: outward-confirm
key.summary: Sending a message or placing a call
key.description: countdown: once Vibe has read back a message or a call to someone the user named, it goes after 3 seconds unless the user says or taps cancel. wait: it goes only when the user says or taps send. A recipient Vibe had to guess, a locked phone or a voice that is not the owner's always waits.

key.name: access-calls
key.description: "Phone calls" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.
